about: English for the classical phrases the reviewers quote in their reasons, shown beside them on the review board (the user does not read Chinese). Plain glosses by Claude, from the phrase's place in the text.

glosses.先迷後得主: first lost, then finds its lord
glosses.先迷失道，後順得常: going first it loses the way; following, it finds the constant
glosses.利建侯: it is fitting to appoint helpers
glosses.再三瀆: asking two or three times is disrespect
glosses.初筮告，再三瀆，瀆則不告: the first asking is answered; asking again and again is disrespect, and disrespect gets no answer
glosses.初筮告，再三瀆: the first asking is answered; asking again and again is disrespect
glosses.剛健而不陷: strong and firm, it does not fall in
glosses.中吉，終凶: stopping halfway is good; pushing to the end is bad
glosses.能以眾正: able to make the many upright
glosses.後夫凶: the one who comes late meets misfortune
glosses.幽人貞吉: the quiet recluse, staying true, has good fortune
glosses.中不自亂: centred, it does not throw itself into disorder
glosses.同人于野: fellowship out in the open field
glosses.不私於物，物亦公焉: not partial to anyone, so everyone is fair to it
glosses.君子有終: the noble one carries it through
glosses.卑而不可踰: low, yet cannot be stepped over
glosses.勞而不伐: works hard and takes no credit
glosses.勿疑，朋盍簪: no doubts, and friends gather like hair in a clasp
glosses.以欲隨宜: letting desire follow what is fitting
glosses.上无其應，无所偏係: no partner above, so no one-sided tie
glosses.官有渝，貞吉: the post changes; staying true brings good fortune
glosses.容保民无疆: embraces and protects the people without limit
glosses.上之化下猶風之靡草: those above change those below as wind bends the grass
glosses.觀民之俗以察己道: look at the people's ways to examine one's own
glosses.利用獄: it is fitting to use the courts
glosses.明罰敕法: makes penalties clear and the laws firm
glosses.无敢折獄: does not dare to decide lawsuits (by show)
glosses.飾終反素: at the end, adornment returns to plain
glosses.上以厚下安宅: those above make those below secure, and so their own house is safe
glosses.不利有攸往: it does not pay to go anywhere
glosses.順而止之: go along with it and stop
glosses.至日閉關: on the solstice the passes were closed
glosses.无妄之疾: an illness not of one's own making
glosses.本末弱: weak at the root and the tip
glosses.行險而不失其信: goes through danger without losing its trust
glosses.水流而不盈: water flows and never fills up
glosses.柔麗乎中正: the soft clings to the central and correct
glosses.遯尾厲: retreating at the tail is dangerous
glosses.自昭明德: makes his own bright virtue shine
glosses.失得勿恤: don't worry about loss or gain
glosses.不代下任: does not do the work of those below
glosses.明不可息: the light cannot be put out
glosses.天地睽而其事同: heaven and earth are apart, but their work is one
glosses.往蹇來: going on means trouble; coming back is better
glosses.反身修德: turns back to oneself and works on his virtue
glosses.二簋可用享: two bowls are enough for the offering
glosses.有過則改: if there is a fault, correct it
glosses.告自邑: announce it to one's own town
glosses.所尚乃窮: what it values comes to an end
glosses.孚號有厲: call out with trust; there is danger
glosses.施命誥四方: issues his orders to the four quarters
glosses.勿用取女: do not take this woman as a wife
glosses.王假有廟: the king comes to his temple
glosses.積小以高大: piles up the small to become high and great
glosses.用見大人: fitting to see the great man
glosses.納而不距: takes it in and doesn't block it
glosses.任而不專: trusts it and doesn't keep it to himself
glosses.困而不失其所: pressed, yet does not lose its place
glosses.革言三就: talk of the change comes round three times
glosses.已日乃孚: on its own day it is trusted
glosses.恐懼脩省: in fear, puts himself in order and examines himself
glosses.思不出其位: thinks no further than his own place
glosses.上下敵應: above and below face each other and don't answer
glosses.時止則止: when it's time to stop, stop
glosses.不素飽: doesn't eat his fill for nothing
glosses.征凶，位不當: going out brings misfortune; the place is not right
glosses.永終知敝: seeing the end, knows what goes wrong
glosses.室主猶存: the lady of the house is still there
glosses.反歸待時: goes back and waits for the time
glosses.宜照天下: should shine on all the world
glosses.日中則昃: at noon the sun begins to sink
glosses.先庚三日後庚三日: three days before the change, three days after
glosses.說不在諂: joy that doesn't come from flattery
glosses.來兌凶: joy that comes seeking is bad
glosses.渙汗其大號，王居: dispersing, the great decree spreads like sweat; the king's dwelling
glosses.王乃在中: the king is at the centre
glosses.苦節不可貞: bitter restraint cannot be kept up
glosses.不宜上宜下: not fitting to go up, fitting to go down
glosses.哀以求處: grieves and seeks a place to rest
glosses.思患而豫防: thinks of trouble and guards against it early
glosses.初吉終亂: good at first, disorder at the end
glosses.飲酒濡首: drinks wine and wets his head
